name: postar-pipe-mcp
description: Unified CI/CD MCP Server - orchestrates GitLab and Jenkins MCPs with dynamic skills

scripts.build: vite build && npm run copy:skills && npm run copy:scripts
scripts.build:tsc: tsc && npm run copy:skills && npm run copy:scripts
scripts.pkg:build: npm run build && npx @yao-pkg/pkg dist/server.js -t node24-macos-arm64 -o release/postar-pipe-mcp-macos-arm64 --config package.json
scripts.pkg:update: node -e "import('./scripts/config.js').then(async c => { const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf-8')); pkg.pkg.targets = c.PKG_TARGETS; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('✅ package.json 已更新'); await import('./scripts/sync-build-yaml.js'); })"
scripts.release: npm version patch && git push && git push --tags && npm run watch:release
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push && git push --tags && npm run watch:release
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push && git push --tags && npm run watch:release

author: zhangkr
